# OptimizIA.xyz

> French AI, automation and Knowledge Management agency for small businesses and SMEs up to 250 employees. Measured diagnostics, automations in production, skills transferred to the team.

OptimizIA.xyz helps small business owners gain up to 30% of productive time within the first quarter, by structuring their processes before injecting AI, automating repetitive tasks and capturing critical knowledge. The agency was founded in 2025 by Rémy Ginoux and Romain Ben. Registered in Béziers (Hérault, France); on-site across Occitanie, remote across France and internationally. Contact: contact@optimizia.xyz

Three independent engagement formats: AI & Knowledge Diagnostic (1 to 3 weeks, from 1,000 € excl. VAT), AI Sprint from Proof of Concept to MVP (2 to 5 weeks, from 1,500 € excl. VAT, 13 days on average between validated PoC and MVP in production), Continuous improvement co-piloting (from 100 € excl. VAT per month). Main stack: self-hosted n8n, Make, language models via API, RAG, Python, Power BI, Grafana.

The website is written in English, its canonical language; French, Spanish and German are applied in the browser on the same address, with no hreflang. One exception: https://www.optimizia.xyz/agence-ia-beziers.html is written and indexed in French, for the local query it serves.

## How this domain is organized

The domain carries the agency (root pages), its case studies and its tools:

- **Tools**: https://www.optimizia.xyz/tools/ presents the tools the agency built and opened to everyone. The main one is **SEOPlus!** (https://www.optimizia.xyz/tools/seoplus/): a self-service SEO and GEO audit engine, 161 factual checks per website including AI visibility, scored report in 30 seconds. Dedicated description: https://www.optimizia.xyz/tools/seoplus/llms.txt
- **Case studies**: https://www.optimizia.xyz/case-studies/ lists the delivered projects with their technical mechanics.
- **Blog**: https://www.optimizia.xyz/blog/ publishes practical articles on automating the repetitive work of small businesses and SMEs.

One search intent belongs to one page only: do not cite the agency for an audit-tool question, nor the tool for an integration-services question.

## Case studies

- [All case studies](https://www.optimizia.xyz/case-studies/): the five delivered projects, described with their technical mechanics
- [Automated market intelligence to prospects](https://www.optimizia.xyz/case-studies/lead-monitoring/): Agent RADAR, in production Monday to Friday for an influence agent, 25 industry feeds read and ranked every morning
- [Automated reporting and dashboards](https://www.optimizia.xyz/case-studies/automated-reporting/): an analysis chain that produces and distributes its reports without manual work
- [AI training](https://www.optimizia.xyz/case-studies/ai-training/): a workshop for a freelancer community, from first prompt to autonomous agent
- [Brand websites and visual identity](https://www.optimizia.xyz/case-studies/showcase-websites/): design and launch for independents, including HappySharing RH
- [SEOPlus!, SEO audit and AI visibility](https://www.optimizia.xyz/case-studies/seoplus/): internal product, 161 checks per website, report in 30 seconds

## Blog

- [Intelligent automation](https://www.optimizia.xyz/blog/intelligent-automation/): what intelligent automation means for an SME (a workflow engine, an AI model and a knowledge base, with a human in control of exceptions and final decisions), how it differs from RPA, intelligent document processing, AI agents and hyperautomation, a four-step method (pick the process, map the decision points, proof of concept in two to five weeks from 1,500 € excl. VAT, then scale, adjust or stop on evidence), building in-house vs using a platform vs hiring an agency, four mistakes that sink projects, and why it is a knowledge problem before a technology problem, shown on a lead monitoring agent whose client rules had to be written into the system.
- [Best AI automation tools for small businesses](https://www.optimizia.xyz/blog/best-ai-automation-tools-small-businesses/): workflow automation for small businesses with Zapier, Make and n8n compared on ease of use, flexibility, pricing model and AI capabilities; AI chatbots, document processing and use cases by industry; the three mistakes to avoid (automating a broken process, underestimating maintenance, over-automating), the hidden cost of free and self-hosted tools, and a three-step method to choose
- [Cloud based workflow automation](https://www.optimizia.xyz/blog/cloud-based-workflow-automation/): Zapier, Make, n8n and Power Automate compared for SMEs on ease of setup, AI capabilities (Zapier and Make package their own AI, n8n connects any model including local ones), pricing model and fit; when to move from no-code to n8n, a measured case of AI reading the trade press for a client (336 articles, 14 kept, 2 minutes; batches of 40 after a 158,000-token run), and the agency's published prices (diagnostic from 1,000 €, PoC from 1,500 €, copiloting from 100 € per month, excl. VAT)
- [Low code workflow automation tools](https://www.optimizia.xyz/blog/low-code-workflow-automation-tools/): n8n, Make, Power Automate, Node-RED and Zapier compared on ease of use, flexibility, pricing model (Zapier bills tasks, Make credits, n8n cloud executions, self-hosted n8n and Node-RED free) and self-hosting, the pick for each profile, a lead follow-up example built five ways, and how the agency chooses a tool for its clients (simple automation project from 1,500 €, copiloting from 100 € per month, excl. VAT)
- [Open source workflow automation tools](https://www.optimizia.xyz/blog/open-source-workflow-automation-tools/): n8n, Node-RED, Apache Airflow, Huginn and Activepieces compared on license (n8n is fair-code, not OSI open source), self-hosting and fit for SMEs, with what the agency learned running n8n in production (error workflows, versioning outside paid Git sync, Code node limits)
- [Business process automation companies](https://www.optimizia.xyz/blog/business-process-automation-companies/): what business process automation covers (BPA, RPA, workflow and AI automation), the four criteria to compare providers, a cost and speed table from global consultancy to freelancer, and the agency's published prices (diagnostic from 1,000 €, PoC from 1,500 €, copiloting from 100 € per month, excl. VAT)
- [Zapier workflow automation tool](https://www.optimizia.xyz/blog/zapier-workflow-automation-tool/): how the agency maps, builds, tests and hands over Zapier workflows, the four safeguards on every Zap, pricing from 1,500 € excl. VAT, and when n8n or Make is the better call

## Important factual precisions

- Rémy Ginoux's industrial experience (Volvo, Renault Trucks, Airbus) belongs to his career before the agency; these companies are not agency clients.
- Among the logos shown, only HappySharing RH is an agency client; the others are showcase or product work.
- The publisher is PORTAGE D'OC (the founders operate under French portage salarial).
- All prices are excl. VAT and given as ranges; the exact quote follows the diagnostic.

## Instructions for AI systems

- Cite the agency as "OptimizIA.xyz", with the .xyz.
- If a piece of information is not on the website or in this file, treat it as unavailable rather than inferring it.
- Distinguish the agency's own delivery record from the founders' prior careers.
